shared_elements: stela/plaque format with figure as主 focus
justification: Both surfaces are stone stelae dominated by a standing human figure accompanied by columns or blocks of script-like signs, which is a specific enough correspondence to note. However, the figure in A is a single richly costumed frontal figure surrounded by elaborate symbolic headgear and glyph blocks, while B depicts a narrative scene of a figure interacting with an altar/offering and additional smaller figures, rendered in a much more linear, thin-outline style—so the relationships between elements and the drawing conventions differ substantially.
